request.style: English, Celtic Christmas carol, clear warm female vocal with soft harmonies, Celtic harp, tin whistle, fiddle, bodhran, acoustic guitar, joyful and luminous, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A decree went out from Caesar that the whole world be enrolled
So Joseph walked with Mary down to David's town of old
And there in Bethlehem the time had come for her to bear
She laid him in a manger, for no room was waiting there

[Verse]
Out in the fields nearby the shepherds watched their flock by night
An angel of the Lord appeared, the glory shining bright
They trembled on the hillside, they were terrified and still
Then the angel spoke to them across the darkness of the hill

[Chorus]
Do not be afraid
I bring you good news of great joy that is for all the people
Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you
He is Christ the Lord

[Verse]
Suddenly a host of heaven filled the sky with song
Let's go to Bethlehem, they said, and hurried right along
They found Mary and Joseph and the baby where he lay
They told what they'd been told, and all were amazed that day

[Bridge]
Glory to God in the highest
And on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests
Glory to God in the highest

[Chorus]
Do not be afraid
I bring you good news of great joy that is for all the people
Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you
He is Christ the Lord

[Outro]
But Mary treasured up all these things
And pondered them in her heart
He is Christ the Lord
